tables.title: Tx MAC flow control
tables.text_helper: Table 811, "Tx MAC flow control", in section 76.5.11 (Flow control) on page 4089. Columns: EHFC, TFE, DM, Description. 5 data row(s).

rows:
The MAC transmitter does not perform the flow 
control or backpressure operation.

The MAC transmitter performs backpressure when 
Bit 0 of Tx Queue 0 flow control register 
(ETH_MACQ0TXFCR) is set.

The MAC transmitter performs backpressure when 
Bit 0 of Tx Queue 0 flow control register 
(ETH_MACQ0TXFCR) is set. In addition, the MAC 
Tx performs backpressure when Rx queue level 
crosses the threshold set by Bits[10:8] of Rx queue x 
operating mode register (ETH_MTLRXQxOMR).

The MAC transmitter sends the Pause packet when 
Bit 0 of Tx Queue 0 flow control register 
(ETH_MACQ0TXFCR) is set.

The MAC transmitter sends the Pause packet when 
Bit 0 of Tx Queue 0 flow control register 
(ETH_MACQ0TXFCR) is set. In addition, the MAC 
Tx sends a Pause packet when Rx queue level 
crosses the threshold set by Bits[10:8] of Rx queue x 
operating mode register (ETH_MTLRXQxOMR).
